requires.degrade: Without jq, the tracker seam and the work-item scripts cannot parse tracker data and stop; no item is listed, claimed or filed.
Without gh, the GitHub provider cannot be used and its claim, list and filing verbs stop; the local-markdown provider still works.

Without curl, the Linear, Jira and Gitea or Forgejo providers cannot reach their APIs, and the triage board's session watcher does not start, so the board closes the loop with a copied reply; the github and local-markdown providers are unaffected.
Without Python 3, the triage board cannot reach the session and closes the loop with a copied reply; the attention view and its table are unaffected.

Without az, every Azure line in the morning brief's Cost section prints UNREADABLE and says to install az; with az logged out, each prints UNREADABLE and says to run az login. The GitHub lines and every other section still render, and the brief exits 6.
Without node, the prerequisites checker cannot run, so a missing tool above goes unreported; and the lane telemetry upsert refuses to post, since its leak scan runs on node.
